title: Prototype the walking task as an Isaac Lab manager-based environment
summary: The MuJoCo surrogate now imports the native observation, termination, load and telemetry arithmetic in place of its own copies; a seeded surrogate run is bit-identical before and after. A manager-based prototype of the walking task sits beside the certified Direct task: one configuration with a slew-limited action term, a command-bank term, 26 reward terms (one per recorded reward component), a 400 Hz load recorder and the stock RSL-RL wrapper. CPU tests match its reward memory, command draws, state, loads and wrapper outputs to the Direct task bit for bit.
next: Run the native parity harness on the prototype in the certification run that renews the c48_long receipt for the reformatted runtime.
reason: The prototype has no native run or admission. The c48_long receipts bind the runtime of source 717548d5, which the Ruff reformat already changed; the pending certification of main's runtime can bind these files as well.
